info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Card By Param1-spec
info.description: The Merchant Acquiring Facility Card Update API allows businesses to modify specific details of a card associated with a merchant acquiring facility by utilizing a unique parameter. This operation primarily targets the flexibility needed in managing card information, catering to financial institutions, payment processors, and merchants. Users can update vital card attributes to reflect changes in business needs or compliance requirements. Typical use cases include adjusting card limits, updating merchant details, or modifying authorization settings, ensuring that organizations can effectively respond to dynamic business environments.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific Merchant Acquiring Facility identified by the provided ID. The request body should contain the necessary fields to be updated.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the properties of a merchant acquiring facility with the identifier "MER-800045." It allows the client to provide the required updates in JSON format.
